title: Tensor inheritance of the geometric-stalk base-change condition
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and work with algebraic spaces over $S$ and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the canonical tensor pullback and direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], their total derived functors computed by K-flat resolutions with flat terms and K-injective resolutions, and K-flat derived tensor product. Write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ for objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y'\to Y$ be morphisms, and set $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ with projections $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$. For a geometric point $\bar x':\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X'$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed, write $\bar x=g'\bar x'$, $\bar y'=f'\bar x'$, $\bar y=f\bar x$, and put $R=\mathcal O_{Y,\bar y}$, $A=\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$, $B=\mathcal O_{Y',\bar y'}$, $C=\mathcal O_{X',\bar x'}$, $D=A\otimes_R B$. The stalks are colimits over pointed etale scheme neighbourhoods, and $D\to C$ is induced by the projection stalk maps. For $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$, $K'\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'})$ and $\phi:L(g')^*K\to K'$, define the stalk comparison $\beta^i_{\phi,\bar x'}$ to be
$$H^i(K_{\bar x}\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B)\otimes_D C\longrightarrow H^i(K'_{\bar x'}).$$
Here the arrow is induced by $K_{\bar x}\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B\to K_{\bar x}\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}C\simeq(L(g')^*K)_{\bar x'}\xrightarrow{\phi_{\bar x'}}K'_{\bar x'}$, extended $C$-linearly on cohomology. Assume $\beta^i_{\phi,\bar x'}$ is an isomorphism for every geometric $\bar x'$ and every $i\in\mathbf Z$. For every $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$, the coefficient map
$$\psi:L(g')^*(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K)\simeq L(g')^*E\otimes^{\mathbf L}L(g')^*K\xrightarrow{1\otimes\phi}L(g')^*E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K'$$
has isomorphisms $\beta^i_{\psi,\bar x'}$ for every geometric $\bar x'$ and every integer $i$, using the same definition with $E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K$ and $L(g')^*E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K'$ in place of $K,K'$. No boundedness of $E$ and no flatness of the square is required.

proof.text: First the proposed coefficient map has the required domain: derived pullback and derived tensor preserve quasi-coherent cohomology by [lem-sfb-space-derived-qcoh-pullback-tensor]. Thus both $E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K$ and $L(g')^*E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K'$ lie in the indicated $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$. The canonical derived tensor pullback isomorphism is that of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], applied to the ringed small etale topoi. In particular it is computed by the ordinary balanced tensor comparison on K-flat resolutions with flat terms.

source.place: Tag 0DKI, proof, first paragraph; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A4

proof.text: Choose K-flat flat-term resolutions $P^\bullet,Q^\bullet$ representing $E,K$, using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Choose a K-injective representative $I^\bullet$ of $K'$ by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Since $(g')^*Q^\bullet$ represents $L(g')^*K$, the morphism $\phi$ is represented by a chain map $a:(g')^*Q^\bullet\to I^\bullet$, by [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]. No quasi-isomorphism is asserted for $a$. The sites are small relative to the module universe, as required by these resolution results.

source.place: Tag 0DKI, clause (1), K-flat computation; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YS, 07A5; derived.tex Tag 070I

proof.text: Fix a geometric $\bar x'$ and use the rings $R,A,B,C,D$ in the statement. Put $U=P_{\bar x}$, $Q=Q^\bullet_{\bar x}$, $N=I_{\bar x'}$, and $F(M)=C\otimes_A M$ termwise. Exactness of normalized module stalks identifies these with representatives of the derived stalks. The K-flat stalk criterion makes $U,Q$ K-flat over $A$. By [lem-sfb-space-geometric-stalk-tensor-calculus], $C$ is flat over $D=A\otimes_R B$, and the stalk of $a$ is a chain map $t:F(Q)\to N$ representing $\phi_{\bar x'}$ under the specified derived pullback comparison. These assertions require neither $A$ nor $B$ to be flat over $R$.

source.place: Tag 0DKG, geometric stalk setup and proof; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0DEN

proof.text:
By [lem-pur-kflat-total-tensor-model], $\operatorname{Tot}(P^\bullet\otimes Q^\bullet)$ is K-flat with flat terms and represents $E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K$; hence $(g')^*\operatorname{Tot}(P^\bullet\otimes Q^\bullet)$ represents $L(g')^*(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K)$, and $\psi$ is represented by the ordinary module pullback tensor comparison of [def-weil-pbc-canonical-ringed-tensor-comparison] followed by $1\otimes a$. The signed total tensor stalk comparison identifies $(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}K)_{\bar x}$ with $U\otimes_A Q$. The complexes $(g')^*P^\bullet,(g')^*Q^\bullet$ remain K-flat by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], so their stalks $F(U),F(Q)$ are K-flat over $C$ by the stalk criterion. Hence the stalk of the target of $\psi$ is represented by $F(U)\otimes_C N$. In these coordinates $\psi_{\bar x'}$ is represented by
$$F(U\otimes_A Q)\xrightarrow{\tau}F(U)\otimes_C F(Q)\xrightarrow{1\otimes t}F(U)\otimes_C N.$$
Here $\tau(c\otimes(u\otimes q))=(c\otimes u)\otimes(1\otimes q)$. The normalized inverse-image tensor comparison preserves pure tensors, and the pure-tensor equation of [def-weil-pbc-canonical-ringed-tensor-comparison] (the scalar-extension insertion $q$ sends $m$ to $1\otimes m$) shows that the ordinary pullback comparison, whose derived class is the canonical derived pullback comparison, has stalk $\tau$. Thus this is precisely the inverse scalar-extension tensorator in the ring inheritance lemma. On a homogeneous $(p,q)$ summand, both routes preserve the order $u,q$, and the differential is $d_U\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_Q$; no symmetry or extra sign is introduced.

source.place: Tag 0DKI, clause (1), tensor computation; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 07A4, 0DEN

proof.text:
For each of the $A$-complexes $M=Q$ and $M=U\otimes_A Q$, take the universal derived extension and its $D$-linear cohomology action supplied by [lem-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-action]. The ordinary identification sends $b\otimes m$ to $(1\otimes b)\otimes m$. Extend its counit on cohomology $D$-linearly to $C$, as in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], to obtain models $m_Q,m_{UQ}$. Concretely the localized comparison is characterized by
$$h\otimes c\longmapsto c\,H^i(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B\longrightarrow C\otimes_A M)(h).$$
For $M=Q$, following this by $H^i(t)$ gives $\beta^i_{\phi,\bar x'}$: the arrow before $H^i(t)$ is exactly the derived-to-ordinary scalar-extension comparison used in the geometric stalk formula, and $t$ represents $\phi_{\bar x'}$. This is an equality of the canonical comparison maps, with the canonical $D$-action, not just an identification of their source and target groups.

Apply [lem-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-inheritance] to these rings, $U,Q,N,t,m_Q,m_{UQ}$. Its flatness hypothesis is the flatness of $C$ over $D$ from step 3, its two K-flatness hypotheses are also from step 3, and its hypothesis in every degree is exactly the assumed invertibility of $\beta^j_{\phi,\bar x'}$ by step 5. It gives invertibility, for every $i$, of the localized comparison for $U\otimes_A Q$ followed by the cohomology of $(1\otimes t)\tau$. The theorem permits arbitrary unbounded complexes.

source.place: Tag 0DKI, clause (1), transitivity of tensor; perfect.tex Tag 0DJA(1), ring-level computation using more-algebra.tex Tag 0BYJ

proof.text: Apply the formula of step 5 with $M=U\otimes_A Q$. By the explicit representative of step 4, its composite with $H^i((1\otimes t)\tau)$ is $\beta^i_{\psi,\bar x'}$. It is an isomorphism by step 6. Since $\bar x'$ and $i$ were arbitrary, all required comparisons are isomorphisms. The proof introduced no degree bounds and used only $D\to C$ flatness, so it imposes no flatness on the original square.

lean.statement: theorem singleComplexTensorInheritance {S : Scheme.{u}} [∀ Z : AlgebraicSpace S, HasDerivedCategory.{w} Z.SmallModules] {X X' Y Y' : AlgebraicSpace S} (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (K : X.DerivedQCoh) (K' : X'.DerivedQCoh) (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K.obj ⟶ K'.obj) (h_stalk : StalkCondition f f' g g' sq K.obj K'.obj φ) : ∀ E : X.DerivedQCoh, StalkCondition f f' g g' sq ((tensor X).obj (E.obj, K.obj)) ((tensor X').obj ((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj, K'.obj)) ((derivedTensorComparison g').hom.app (E.obj, K.obj) ≫ (tensor X').map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((derivedPullback g').obj E.obj)) φ))
